latestVersion.changelog:
generator-online 1.0.0 changelog:

- Initial release of the Generator Online skill for creating and exporting videos online from text or media files.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, and other media types up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4.
- AI-powered video generation with typical processing times of 1–2 minutes, no software installation required.
- Handles common workflows: quick edit, batch processing, and iterative refinement, all in the cloud.
- Connects automatically, manages anonymous tokens, session handling, and export workflow with clear status feedback.
- Actionable user intents (generate, export, check credits, upload, etc.) are classified and routed for a streamlined experience.
